output.question: What are Disney's latest financial statements?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Disney's latest available financial statements are the unaudited Condensed Consolidated Statements in its Form 10-Q filed August 5, 2026, covering the quarter and nine months ended June 27, 2026; the SEC filing history lists this as the newest Disney 10-Q/10-K filing retrieved. [5](#cite-5) For the nine months ended June 27, 2026, Disney reported revenue of $76.397 billion, net income of $7.793 billion, and cash provided by operations of $12.515 billion; for the quarter, revenue was $25.248 billion and net income was $2.844 billion. [2](#cite-2) At June 27, 2026, Disney reported total assets of $204.740 billion, cash and cash equivalents of $5.185 billion, total liabilities of $87.898 billion, and total shareholders' equity of $116.842 billion.
